sentences.zh: 我知道我们要一起拼车，但你要搞那个捉弄德怀特的恶作剧，而且你得在凌晨3点出发，我要睡个懒觉。

sentences.en: Like, what's the real life side of that?
sentences.zh: 就像，这在现实生活中是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I reached out to Randy to find out how we did this stunt of Rain up on this telephone pole.
sentences.zh: 我联系了兰迪，想了解我们是怎么拍雷恩在电线杆上那个特技镜头的。

sentences.en: Right, he can't climb a real telephone pole.
sentences.zh: 没错，他不可能真的去爬电线杆。

sentences.en: No, because what he told me was that the pole over Jim's shoulder really is an actual working utility pole that's embedded in our sidewalk, you know, right out there.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为他告诉我，吉姆肩膀后面的那根电线杆实际上是一根真正的、正在使用的公用电线杆，就埋在我们外面的人行道上。

sentences.en: Folks, don't go climb it for a photo.
sentences.zh: 各位，千万别为了拍照去爬它。

sentences.en: Yeah, it carried high voltage electricity.
They couldn't even have a stunt person dressed as Dwight climb that pole.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不能找个替身演员打扮成德怀特去爬那根杆子。

sentences.en: So, our production designer, Michael Gallenberg, and his construction team rented a matching utility pole.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们的美术指导迈克尔·加伦伯格和他的施工团队租了一根一模一样的电线杆。

sentences.en: You can do that, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这种事居然也能办到。

sentences.en: I mean, seriously, how do they know these things?
sentences.zh: 我是说，说真的，他们是怎么知道这些门道的？

sentences.en: This is the crazy part of Hollywood magic.
sentences.zh: 这就是好莱坞魔法疯狂的地方。

sentences.en: Oh, you know what I'm going to do today?
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道我今天要做什么吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to rent a fakie telephone pole.
sentences.zh: 我要去租一根假电线杆。

sentences.en: Well, they put it up in our parking lot between the two sound stages, and they put, like, a green padded platform around it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们把它竖在我们两个摄影棚之间的停车场里，还在周围放了一个绿色软垫平台。

sentences.en: And they put up a big green screen behind the whole thing, and then they brought Rain out along with, like, a stunt coordinator and a safety officer, and they had Rain climb up.
sentences.zh: 他们在整个装置后面竖起了一块巨大的绿幕，然后带着雷恩，还有特技协调员和安全员一起出来，让雷恩爬了上去。

sentences.en: It was only a few feet that he had to climb.
sentences.zh: 他其实只需要爬几英尺高。

sentences.en: And then, in post-production, they had their visual effects team digitally add Rain to the real pole over Jim's shoulder.
sentences.zh: 然后，在后期制作中，他们的视觉特效团队通过数字技术把雷恩加到了吉姆肩膀后面那根真正的电线杆上。

sentences.en: They superimpose, like, one pole onto the other.
sentences.zh: 他们把一根杆子叠加到了另一根上。

sentences.en: Even though Rain was really only a little bit off the ground, they could, like, hike it up so it looked like he was, like, halfway up the pole.
sentences.zh: 尽管雷恩当时离地只有一点点高，但他们可以把它调高，看起来就像他爬到了电线杆的一半高一样。

sentences.en: That is some good movie magic.
sentences.zh: 那确实是很棒的电影魔法。

sentences.en: But here's the thing that gets me about that.
sentences.zh: 但关于这一点，最让我感慨的是。

sentences.en: That's, like, real special effects kind of, like, stunty stuff for our little TV show about a paper company.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这个关于造纸公司的小型电视剧来说，这简直是真正的特效特技。

sentences.en: Like, I never really thought hard about how much work it took to do that gag until we went to break it down.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没认真想过，直到我们开始拆解这个桥段，才发现为了拍那个恶作剧花了多少心血。

sentences.en: Like, it's such a quick little blip, and you're like, that was, like, two weeks of figuring that out.
sentences.zh: 它只是一个转瞬即逝的小片段，但你会想，那可是花了两个星期才搞定的。

sentences.en: I feel like every week we are learning how much Michael Gallenberg, Kyle Alexander, Phil Shea, our wardrobe department, set designers,
sentences.zh: 我觉得每周我们都在了解迈克尔·加伦伯格、凯尔·亚历山大、菲尔·谢，还有我们的服装部门、布景设计师们到底付出了多少努力，

sentences.en: how they all made these little moments happen and made it seamless.
sentences.zh: 他们是如何让这些小瞬间发生并衔接得天衣无缝的。

sentences.en: So much work goes into these little things.
sentences.zh: 这些小细节背后付出了太多心血。

sentences.en: We had to know their, like, mating cycle.
sentences.zh: 我们得了解它们的，比如，交配周期。

sentences.en: Well, that was the cold open.

sentences.zh: 迈克尔在他的办公室里。

sentences.en: He's on the phone with David Wallace.
sentences.zh: 他正在和戴维·华莱士通电话。

sentences.en: I feel like David's really playing Michael here because he dangles out that regional supervisor job.
sentences.zh: 我觉得戴维在这里真的在耍迈克尔，因为他抛出了那个区域主管的职位诱饵。

sentences.en: He's like, you know, I still haven't filled that slot yet.
sentences.zh: 他就像是说，你知道，那个空缺我还没填补呢。

sentences.en: And then he asked Michael to go do this thing.
sentences.zh: 接着他让迈克尔去做这件事。

sentences.en: To go spy on this tiny little paper company.
sentences.zh: 去监视那家小小的造纸公司。

sentences.en: During this scene, I was really struck by the toys on Michael's desk because they would rotate them.
sentences.zh: 在这场戏里，我真的被迈克尔桌上的玩具吸引住了，因为他们会轮换这些玩具。

sentences.en: Every once in a while, there'd be some new toys.
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间，就会出现一些新玩具。

sentences.en: Here's what was on his desk.
sentences.zh: 这是他桌上当时的东西。

sentences.en: A colorful plastic expanding ball thingy.
sentences.zh: 一个彩色的塑料伸缩球玩意儿。
还有那个上发条的假牙。

sentences.en: But the pool table had moved.
So he's clearly played it recently.
sentences.zh: 所以他显然最近玩过它。

sentences.en: And it's on top of all the stuff in his inbox.
sentences.zh: 而且它就放在他收件箱里所有东西的上面。

sentences.en: He can't get to anything in his inbox.
sentences.zh: 他根本没法处理收件箱里的任何东西。

sentences.en: The pool table is number one of things to do.
A miniature pool table in his inbox says everything you need to know about Michael Scott's work ethic.
sentences.zh: 收件箱里的微型台球桌说明了一切，让你了解迈克尔·斯科特的工作态度。

sentences.en: Stanley and Phyllis are going to start having this conversation about whether or not they think Hillary Swank is hot.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利和菲利斯要开始讨论他们是否觉得希拉里·斯万克性感了。

sentences.en: And the rest of the gang gets involved.
sentences.zh: 剩下的伙伴们也都参与了进来。

sentences.en: I feel like these kind of moments happen in small offices.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这种时刻在小办公室里经常发生。

sentences.en: You sort of start to debate things.
sentences.zh: 你们会开始争论一些事情。

sentences.en: Like you pick a soccer team during the playoffs and people debate about the players and it can become a whole thing.
sentences.zh: 比如在季后赛期间选一支足球队，大家会争论球员，然后这事儿就闹大了。

sentences.en: And it's just a way to fill the boredom.
sentences.zh: 这只是打发无聊的一种方式。

sentences.en: I have a bone to pick with Jim.
At 3 minutes 18 seconds, I titled this moment, What the Hell, Jim?
sentences.zh: 在3分18秒的时候，我把这一刻命名为“搞什么鬼，吉姆？”

sentences.en: Jim suggests they put it to a vote in the bullpen.
sentences.zh: 吉姆建议他们在办公区进行投票。

sentences.en: Did you notice what Pam said?
sentences.zh: 你注意到帕姆说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Pam says, did you see her with her bangs?
sentences.zh: 帕姆说，你看到她留刘海的样子了吗？

sentences.en: And lady, this made me laugh out loud because I have just recently gotten bangs.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这让我大笑出声，因为我最近刚剪了刘海。

sentences.en: And people have a lot of opinions about it.
sentences.zh: 人们对这事儿有很多看法。

sentences.en: They do have opinions about my bangs.
sentences.zh: 他们确实对我的刘海有看法。

sentences.en: But what made me laugh was that before I got my bangs, I, of course, Googled images of people with bangs.
sentences.zh: 但让我发笑的是，在我剪刘海之前，我当然在谷歌上搜了留刘海的人的照片。

sentences.en: You don't just, you got to look at all the pictures.
sentences.zh: 你不能随随便便，你得看看所有的照片。

sentences.en: You texted me, I think I'm going to get bangs.
sentences.zh: 你给我发短信说，我想我要去剪刘海了。

sentences.en: To which I replied, oh, no.
I said, I think I'm going to get bangs right now.
sentences.zh: 我说，我想我现在就要去剪刘海了。

sentences.en: Because, like, I was getting a haircut in the moment.
sentences.zh: 因为当时我正在理发店剪头发。

sentences.en: By the time you replied, it was done.
sentences.zh: 等你回复的时候，已经剪完了。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, I was busy with the kids.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，噢，我正忙着照顾孩子呢。

sentences.en: I decided we were going to paint.
I bought the canvas and all the paint stuff were outside.
sentences.zh: 我买了画布，所有的颜料都放在外面。

sentences.en: I'd set my phone aside so I didn't get paint on it.
sentences.zh: 我把手机放在一边，以免弄上颜料。

sentences.en: And then I just thought I'd check in, see what's happening.
sentences.zh: 然后我只是想看看，发生了什么事。

sentences.en: And I see this text from you that's half an hour old that says, I think I'm going to get bangs now.
sentences.zh: 我看到你半小时前发来的短信，上面写着，我想我现在要去剪刘海了。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, no.
I didn't get to weigh in.
But, lady, I think they're adorable.
sentences.zh: 但是，亲爱的，我觉得它们很可爱。

sentences.en: I think they're super cute because they're curly.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它们超级可爱，因为它们是卷的。

sentences.en: I bring it up because one of the people I saw in my research was Hilary Swank with bangs.
sentences.zh: 我提起这个是因为我在研究时看到的人之一是留着刘海的希拉里·斯万克。

sentences.en: So when Pam said this in the scene, it made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 所以当帕姆在这一幕中说这句话时，我笑了。

sentences.en: But I really based my bangs on some, like, Mia Farrow from Hannah and Her Sisters.
sentences.zh: 但我剪刘海其实是参考了《汉娜姐妹》里的米亚·法罗。

sentences.en: You look very 70s, kind of like beachy wave with bangs.
sentences.zh: 你看上去很有七十年代的感觉，有点像海滩波浪卷配刘海。

sentences.en: A little bit of Terry Garr.
Terry Garr wore some bangs like no one's business.
sentences.zh: 泰瑞·加尔留起刘海来那可是无人能及。

sentences.en: But my main inspiration was probably Stevie Nicks.
sentences.zh: 但我主要的灵感来源大概是史蒂薇·尼克斯。

sentences.en: And I will admit that after getting my bangs, I did style my hair in a full Stevie Nicks.
sentences.zh: 我得承认，剪完刘海后，我确实完全复刻了史蒂薇·尼克斯的发型。

sentences.en: And then I took pictures and I put them side by side.
sentences.zh: 然后我拍了照片，把它们放在一起做了对比。

sentences.en: I was too shy to poSt.
sentences.zh: 我当时太害羞了，没敢发出来。

sentences.en: I want to see the side by side.
You want to see my Stevie Nicks picture?
sentences.zh: 你想看我的史蒂薇·尼克斯造型照吗？

sentences.en: Do you have it on your phone?
I mean, I really did this.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我真的这么做了。

sentences.en: Oh, you kind of did the same mouth expression.
sentences.zh: 噢，你连嘴部的表情都模仿得挺像。

sentences.en: I put on the same necklace.
I did, like, a whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我真的是全套装备都用上了。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm doing a whole pouty mouth, so I got a little bit, like, shy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时在嘟嘴，所以觉得有点不好意思。

sentences.en: You even did the dark eyeliner.

sentences.zh: 这可是花了我一下午的时间。

sentences.en: I thought I knew your life.
sentences.zh: 我以为我很了解你的生活。

sentences.en: I didn't know what was happening.
sentences.zh: 我当时都不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: I mean, I had to take off my glasses for the picture.
sentences.zh: 我是说，为了拍照我不得不摘掉眼镜。

sentences.en: Which actually made it a little hard to take the picture.
sentences.zh: 这其实让拍照变得有点困难。

sentences.en: Because I couldn't see very well.
I can't tell you how many photos I've taken of Josh and the kids.
sentences.zh: 我数不清给乔什和孩子们拍过多少照片了。

sentences.en: Because, you know, when you're like a family, one parent has to take the picture.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，作为一家人，总得有一个家长负责拍照。

sentences.en: And half the time, I don't have my glasses, because I'm not good about wearing them.
sentences.zh: 而且有一半时间我都没戴眼镜，因为我不习惯戴。

sentences.en: And Josh will be like, babe, these are out of focus.
sentences.zh: 乔什就会说，宝贝，这些照片都失焦了。

sentences.en: I love how we literally could not be more off topic right now.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们现在完全跑题的样子。

sentences.en: So we are now, oh, God.
You guys, we are about to talk about a scene I absolutely loved.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我们马上要聊到一个我非常喜欢的场景。

sentences.en: It's a driving scene between Dwight and Michael.
sentences.zh: 那是德怀特和迈克尔之间的一场开车戏。

sentences.en: They're headed to Prince Family Paper.
sentences.zh: 他们正前往普林斯家族造纸公司。

sentences.en: Did you notice how much they bicker in this scene?
sentences.zh: 你们注意到他们在这场戏里吵得有多厉害了吗？

sentences.en: They're like an old married couple.
sentences.zh: 他们就像一对老夫老妻。

sentences.en: They bicker about who would seduce the fictional daughter.
sentences.zh: 他们为了谁会去勾引那个虚构的女儿而争吵。

sentences.en: They don't even know if this person exists.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至都不知道这人是否存在。

sentences.en: And they bicker about Denny's and IHOP.
sentences.zh: 他们还为了丹尼餐厅和国际煎饼屋争吵。

sentences.en: Dwight says, get your clouds right.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，把你的云彩搞清楚。

sentences.en: Michael tells them to shut up.
But I have a background catch.
sentences.zh: 但我发现了一个背景细节。

sentences.en: Oh, it sent me down a Google path, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 噢，这让我开启了一段谷歌搜索之旅，珍娜。

sentences.en: So whenever we have driving scenes, we always look for palm trees, right?
sentences.zh: 所以每当有开车戏时，我们总是会找棕榈树，对吧？

sentences.en: In this one, I recognized the street they were on.
sentences.zh: 在这一场里，我认出了他们所在的街道。

sentences.en: And guess what else I recognized?
And there were blue recycle bins in every driveway.
sentences.zh: 每个车道上都有蓝色的回收桶。
我会把它们放进播客里。

sentences.en: So then I thought, is that what the recycle trash bins look like in Scranton?
sentences.zh: 于是我就想，斯克兰顿的垃圾回收桶长那样吗？

sentences.en: So that took me to the recycling laws for Lackawanna County.
sentences.zh: 于是我查了拉克瓦纳县的回收法规。

sentences.en: Hang with me because there's a woman named Barbara who I am now fascinated by.
sentences.zh: 听我说完，因为有个叫芭芭拉的女人，我现在对她着迷了。

sentences.en: First of all, that is not what recycle bins look like in Lackawanna County.
sentences.zh: 首先，拉克瓦纳县的回收桶根本不是长那样的。

sentences.en: So theirs are like these blue round tubs.
sentences.zh: 他们的是那种蓝色的圆桶。

sentences.en: Unless they've changed, you guys can correct me.
sentences.zh: 除非他们换了，你们可以纠正我。

sentences.en: Ours are these like skinny rectangles with lids.
sentences.zh: 我们的是那种带盖子的细长矩形桶。

sentences.en: So here's an article I read from April of 2019.
sentences.zh: 这是我读到的一篇2019年4月的文章。

sentences.en: Barbara Giovinoli is the recycling coordinator for Lackawanna County.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·乔维诺利是拉克瓦纳县的回收协调员。

sentences.en: Barbara shared that the recycling center in Lackawanna County accepts plastics and glass
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉分享说，拉克瓦纳县的回收中心接收塑料和玻璃

sentences.en: bottles and jars, aluminum steel cans, as well as newspaper.
sentences.zh: 瓶子和罐子、铝制钢罐，以及报纸。

sentences.en: It is a dual stream system.
sentences.zh: 这是一个双流回收系统。

sentences.en: They have containers, bottles, jars, and cans in one and paper fibers separately.
sentences.zh: 他们把容器、瓶子、罐子和金属罐放在一个桶里，纸类纤维则分开存放。

sentences.en: They do not accept plastic bags, takeout containers, or pizza boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们不收塑料袋、外卖盒或披萨盒。

sentences.en: And apparently, lady, the recycle centers get all kinds of wacky things.
sentences.zh: 显然，女士，回收中心会收到各种奇奇怪怪的东西。

sentences.en: People put all kinds of crazy things in the recycle bins.
sentences.zh: 人们往回收箱里扔各种疯狂的东西。

sentences.en: Barbara has a tip for you.
She says there's an easy way to remind yourself what can and cannot be recycled at the Lackawanna
sentences.zh: 她说有一个简单的方法可以提醒自己，在拉卡瓦纳县回收中心
什么可以回收，什么不能。

sentences.en: Quote, ask yourself, is it a bottle?
sentences.zh: 引用一下，问问自己，这是瓶子吗？

sentences.en: If the answer is no, that means it has to be thrown away.
sentences.zh: 如果答案是否定的，那就意味着它必须被扔掉。

sentences.en: Ask yourself, is this a jar?
Anyway, this was a random thing I noticed in the background.
sentences.zh: 总之，这是我在背景中偶然注意到的事情。

sentences.en: No palm tree siding, several recycle bins.
sentences.zh: 没有棕榈树壁板，有几个回收箱。

sentences.en: Also in the scene, for those of you guys keeping track of how many times Michael Skarn is mentioned
sentences.zh: 同样在这一幕中，对于那些关注迈克尔·斯卡恩在剧中被提到多少次的人来说，

sentences.en: in the series, this is one of them because it's going to be Michael's alias.
sentences.zh: 这是其中一次，因为这将是迈克尔的化名。

sentences.en: And then they get into a real heated argument.
sentences.zh: 然后他们陷入了一场真正的激烈争论。

sentences.en: I mean, that has history about Denny's and IHOP.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那段关于丹尼餐厅和国际煎饼屋的历史。

sentences.en: They're going to rendezvous after they get the info.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到信息后要去碰头。
迈克尔说在国际煎饼屋。

sentences.en: And Dwight's like, I did not agree to IHOP.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，我没同意去国际煎饼屋。
他说，你是社会主义者吗？

sentences.en: And Michael's like, you are going to IHOP and you will have pancakes and you will like it.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，你得去国际煎饼屋，吃煎饼，而且你会喜欢的。

sentences.en: Do you have strong feelings about IHOP or Denny's?
